flagged.title: Sources of Finance
flagged.reason: The video presents the fabricated funding history of Innocent Smoothies (claiming it grew via small business loans and crowdfunding rather than equity investment from an outside investor), which teaches debt instead of equity and would cause students to be marked wrong on questions in this lesson.

mark_affecting.quote: Early: Grew via small business loans / Later: Crowdfund rounds & share sale / they unlocked external sources, like small business loans.
